abstract: The study consisted of 46 intersexual patients who underwent gonadectomy at the age of 3 months to 19 years because of gonadal dysgenesis (GD; 40 cases) or true hermaphroditism (bisexual gonads; 6 cases). In patients with GD, the incidence of the 46,XY karyotype was 67.5%, whereas the remaining patients exhibited numerical and structural aberrations of sex chromosomes (NSASs), and all patients with bisexual gonads revealed NSAS. Seminoma was diagnosed in 1 patient with the 46,XY karyotype and pure GD (streak gonads). Intratubular carcinoma in situ (CIS) appeared as an exclusive lesion in 61.5% of 13 patients with mixed GD, in 54% of 11 patients with partial GD (bilateral testes), in 16.7% of 6 patients with bisexual gonads, and in none of 13 patients with pure GD. CIS also appeared in tubules in the vicinity of sex cord-derived tumors (gonadoblastoma nests and unclassified mixed germ cell-sex cord-stromal tumor; MGCSCST) and within the tumors. In 3 patients, gonadoblastoma replaced the whole bilateral gonads and is referred to as gonadoblastoma-only GD. The incidence of neoplastic lesions (mostly bilateral) was 90.9% in patients with partial GD, 76.9% (mostly unilateral) in patients with mixed GD, 23.1% (unilateral) in patients with pure GD, and 16.7% (unilateral) in patients with bisexual gonads. Disregarding types of disturbances of gonadal organogenesis, the incidence of lesions was 71.4% in 28 patients with the 46,XY karyotype and 35.3% in 17 patients with NSAS. We conclude, first, that NSAS is not a prerequisite for the appearance of GD and GD is more frequently associated with the 46,XY karyotype. Second, the spectrum of germ cell neoplastic lesions in GD is wider than reported. Besides germ cell carcinoma, CIS, and gonadoblastoma nests, the spectrum also includes a tumor of gonadoblastoma-only in cases of GD and MGCSCST. Third, the incidence of neoplastic lesions is related more to the severity of the disturbances of gonadal organogenesis than it is to aberrations in sex chromosomes. Fourth, less disturbed testicular organogenesis predisposes these patients more toward germ cell neoplastic lesions, which suggests that the testicular environment of a dysgenetic gonad plays an important role in germ cell neoplasia initiation, maintenance, or both.
abstract_ja: 性腺形成異常（GD; 40例）または真性半陰陽（両性性腺; 6例）のため、生後3か月から19歳の間に性腺摘出術を受けた間性患者46例を対象とした。GD患者では46,XY核型の割合が67.5%であり、残りの患者は性染色体の数的・構造的異常（NSAS）を示した。両性性腺の患者は全例でNSASを示した。純粋GD（線維性索状性腺）の46,XY核型の1例にセミノーマが診断された。精細管内上皮内癌（CIS）は、混合性GD患者13例中61.5%、部分性GD（両側精巣）患者11例中54%、両性性腺患者6例中16.7%に単独病変として認められ、純粋性GD患者13例中には認められなかった。CISは、性索由来腫瘍（性腺芽腫の巣および分類不能の混合性胚細胞-性索間質腫瘍、MGCSCST）の周囲の精細管内や腫瘍内にも認められた。3例では性腺芽腫が両側の性腺全体を置き換えており、これを性腺芽腫のみのGDと呼ぶ。腫瘍性病変の発生率は、部分性GD患者で90.9%（多くは両側性）、混合性GD患者で76.9%（多くは片側性）、純粋性GD患者で23.1%（片側性）、両性性腺患者で16.7%（片側性）であった。性腺器官形成障害の種類を問わなければ、46,XY核型の28例では71.4%、NSASの17例では35.3%に病変が認められた。第一に、NSASはGDの出現に必須ではなく、GDはより高頻度で46,XY核型と関連する。第二に、GDにおける胚細胞の腫瘍性病変のスペクトラムは従来の報告より広く、胚細胞癌、CIS、性腺芽腫の巣に加え、性腺芽腫のみのGDの腫瘍およびMGCSCSTも含まれる。第三に、腫瘍性病変の発生率は性染色体異常よりも性腺器官形成障害の重症度と関連している。第四に、性腺の障害が少ないほど、これらの患者は胚細胞の腫瘍性病変を生じやすく、性腺異形成における精巣環境が胚細胞腫瘍の発生と維持の両方に重要な役割を果たすことが示唆される。
